title: Profile: display name survives reload
subtitle: Saving a display name now persists it on the server
criteria: Saving a new display name shows it in the page header
The saved display name is still shown after a full page reload
Risk: an empty display name is rejected with an error and not saved

changed_behaviors: The profile form saves the display name through PUT /api/profile
The page header reads the display name from GET /api/profile on load
risks: The header updates from local state only, so the name is lost on reload
Validation exists only in the form, so an empty name reaches the server
assumptions: The development server seeds a signed-in user whose display name is Ada

shots.criterion: Saving a new display name shows it in the page header
shots.setup: Open http://localhost:3000/profile; the header shows Ada
shots.do: Replace the Display name field with Grace Hopper and press Save
shots.expect: The header reads Grace Hopper and a Saved message appears
shots.falsifier: The header still reads Ada or no Saved message appears
shots.capture: Video of the header and form after Save
shots.caption: Saving a new name updates the header

shots.criterion: The saved display name is still shown after a full page reload
shots.setup: Depends on shot 1: the name Grace Hopper was saved
shots.do: Reload the page with qareel reload
shots.expect: After reload the header and the field both read Grace Hopper
shots.falsifier: After reload the header or the field reads Ada
shots.caption: The new name survives a full reload

shots.criterion: Risk: an empty display name is rejected with an error and not saved
shots.setup: Depends on shot 2: the saved name is Grace Hopper
shots.do: Clear the Display name field, press Save, then reload the page
shots.expect: The form shows Display name is required, and after reload the header still reads Grace Hopper
shots.falsifier: No error appears, or after reload the header is empty
shots.capture: Video of the error message and of the header after reload
shots.caption: An empty name is rejected and nothing is saved
